trial_court: Principal Judge, Family Court, Bhagalpur in Matrimonial Case No. 250/2011
case_name: Bal Kukund Kumar Das vs Neena Kumari
facts_of_case: The parties are Bal Kukund Kumar Das and Neena Kumari. The husband sought divorce on the ground of desertion. The trial court granted decree of divorce while awarding permanent alimony to the wife. The appeal is against this part of the judgment.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking alimony to establish a fit case for grant of alimony.
legal_principles.held: Having considered the matter, in our opinion, the appeal has to be allowed and the judgment and decree, to the extent in relation to grant of permanent alimony of Rs. 2,00,000 (Rupees Two Lacs) to the respondent under Section 25 of the Hindu Marriage Act, cannot be sustained.

legal_principles.principle: A party's earning capacity is relevant in determining the amount of alimony to be granted.
legal_principles.held: He was earning about Rs. 1000/- only, per month. He could barely manage to support himself.

outcome.final_order: Delay in filing the appeal was condoned, and the appeal stands allowed.

use_for_drafting: condoning delay in filing an appeal
interpreting Section 19(1) of the Family Courts Act
